subject: Scheduling SE demo and procurement/security touchpoint — TenorCloud
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@tenorcloud.com>, Samir Iqbal <samir@tenorcloud.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & scheduling: SE demo + procurement/security touchpoint

Hi Priya / Samir —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our conversation, TenorCloud would like a focused technical demo for your engineering leads and a short procurement/security touchpoint for your vendor onboarding team. To keep this efficient I want to propose two parts: a 40-min SE demo (deep dive on latency/throughput and private deployment options) followed by a 20-min procurement/security Q&A.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Nov 10, 9:30–10:30am PT (demo + 20m Q&A)
- Tue Nov 10, 1:00–2:00pm PT (demo + 20m Q&A)
- Wed Nov 11, 8:00–9:00am PT (short morning slot)

Grace from our Solutions Engineering team is cc'ed and will own the demo content. Aditya from Customer Success will join the procurement/security portion to walk through onboarding and documentation. I’m attaching a draft SOW for your procurement team to glance at (TenorCloud_SOW_v1.pdf).

If you can confirm the right procurement contact (or loop them on this thread) and your preferred window we’ll lock a calendar invite and share the demo runbook.

Thanks —
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0189

Attachment: TenorCloud_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 124KB)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@tenorcloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Iqbal <samir@tenorcloud.com>
Cc: procurement@tenorcloud.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & scheduling: SE demo + procurement/security touchpoint

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for the clear options. Samir and I are available on Tue Nov 10 at 1:00pm PT. I’ve cc'd procurement (procurement@tenorcloud.com) — their lead is Maya Patel and she manages vendor onboarding. Maya, can you confirm if you need anything else in advance (SOC 2, data flow diagrams, FOA)?

Also our engineering lead (two folks) prefer a slightly later start if possible — 1:15pm PT would be even better. Is that workable?

Best,
Priya
VP Product | TenorCloud
priya.shah@tenorcloud.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@tenorcloud.com>, Samir Iqbal <samir@tenorcloud.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & scheduling: SE demo + procurement/security touchpoint

Hi all —

1:15pm PT on Tue Nov 10 works for me. I’ll plan a ~40 minute walkthrough focused on:
- latency profiles on mixed sequence lengths
- dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs for inference economics
- demo of private VPC deployment + key rotation

I’ll attach the slide deck I’ll run through (SE_Demo_Slides.pptx). For the procurement/security portion Aditya can cover onboarding steps and docs, and I can stay on for the first 10 minutes of that Q&A to answer architecture questions.

Quick ask for TenorCloud procurement/security team: if you have a short list of must-have compliance artifacts (SOC 2 Type II, retention policy, audit logs format) please drop them here — we’ll prepare the artifacts before the call.

Thanks —
Grace
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: SE_Demo_Slides.pptx (PPTX, 3.2MB)
From: procurement@tenorcloud.com <procurement@tenorcloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@tenorcloud.com>
Cc: Samir Iqbal <samir@tenorcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & scheduling: SE demo + procurement/security touchpoint

Hello —

This is Maya from TenorCloud procurement. Thanks for looping us in. For our onboarding checklist we need:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest)
- Data retention & deletion policy for customer data
- Network architecture diagram showing egress controls
- Point-of-contact for security audits (name + email + phone)

Can you also confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed key (CMK) for private deployments? A short note on key management options would be helpful ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Director, Procurement | TenorCloud
procurement@tenorcloud.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <procurement@tenorcloud.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@tenorcloud.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & scheduling: SE demo + procurement/security touchpoint

Hi Maya / Priya —

Appreciate the list — we can provide SOC 2 Type II and the network diagram ahead of the session. Short answers: yes, Redwood supports CMK via KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) for Private deployments; we’ll include that in the notes and Grace will show the flow in the demo.

I’ve attached the draft SOW again for procurement review (TenorCloud_SOW_v1.pdf) and the SE deck. Per Priya’s request we’ll start at 1:15pm PT on Tue Nov 10. I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and join info; HubSpot deal is TEN-4921.

Action items:
- Redwood: send SOC 2 (redwood-soc2-2026.pdf) and network diagram before EOD Mon Nov 9. (Grace / Monica)
- TenorCloud procurement: confirm whether you need an executed NDA before the demo.

Thanks —
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael — confirmed for Tue Nov 10, 1:15–2:15pm PT. Procurement: no NDA required at this stage; SOC 2 and network diagram will be sufficient for initial review.

Looking forward to the demo, please include calendar invite and dial-in.

Best,
Priya
